versions.content: function operator== [SWS_CORE_00571] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 constexpr bool operator== (const ErrorCode &lhs, const ErrorCode &rhs) noexcept; Comparison of two ErrorCodes. Two ErrorCode instances compare equal if the results of their Value() and Domain() functions are equal. The result of SupportData() is not considered for equality.
